proposition: The dissertation and the Prologue agree on five years of wandering exile ending in death: the dissertation runs from the 830/1427 arrest to death at Herat in 835/1432 and says Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II was written about five years after 830/1427.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I/II, as reported by Melvin-Koushki
mediation.note: written to the rulers judging him; the dissertation calls the apologies the primary source for his life (pdf 75)
